checks.notes: Bodies are line-ending-normalized and trimmed; names and parameter lists are intentionally outside the body comparison.
checks.rule: A function body of at least 160 LF-normalized characters must not be byte-identical across three or more product files.
checks.title: Byte-identical repeated function bodies

checks.notes: Similarity is multiset Dice similarity over ordered five-token shingles, preserving local control-flow order while normalizing identifiers and literals; SHA-256 identities are emitted for each cluster.
checks.rule: After comment/whitespace removal and identifier/literal normalization, bodies of at least 240 normalized characters with at least 90% ordered five-token-shingle similarity must not span three or more product files.
checks.title: Near-copy function bodies

checks.rule: An identical CSS declaration block containing at least six declarations must not appear in three or more module files.
checks.title: Repeated CSS declaration blocks

checks.notes: Literal values are fingerprinted rather than emitted. Ordinary use sites are excluded; only uppercase domain-definition sites are counted.
checks.rule: The same named domain constant and literal value must not be defined as an authority in two or more product files.
checks.title: Duplicated approved domain constants

checks.notes: Persistent key names are represented by one-way concept IDs; manifest shared assets use the module manifest as their declared authority.
checks.rule: Each application-owned asset or persistent-key concept shared by at least two modules must have exactly one declared product authority.
checks.title: Single authority for shared concepts
